capabilities.name: 反编译
capabilities.description: 查看 JAR、受控反编译、导出参考源码并接管模组或服务端插件为新项目。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_decompile_query
tools.description: Inspect a project JAR, scan references, read its cached decompiled sources or obtain current controlled-decompilation terms. For inspect/files/read/references, sourcePath must identify the original JAR relative to the current project or its user attachments. For read, path identifies the file inside that JAR's decompiled sources. The cache key is computed from the original JAR; optional sourceSha256 only asserts the expected hash and cannot select a different cached JAR. terms needs no sourcePath.

tools.name: modmind_decompile_run
tools.description: Run controlled JAR decompilation into the application source cache after the user has acknowledged the exact current terms version. Never executes the input JAR or writes generated sources into the project.

capabilities.name: FTB 任务书
capabilities.description: 读取、编辑、校验、保存与恢复 FTB Quests 任务书，提供游戏物品和模型图标参照。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_write_ftb_quest
tools.description: Write a validated FTB Quests chapter as SNBT into the modpack overrides.

capabilities.name: 图像生成与编辑
capabilities.description: ModMind 原生图像工坊支持账号额度或自定义图片 API 生图、参考图编辑、节点工作流、PerfectPixel 像素处理及去背景。安装并启用后可在工作台和灵感台调用；未安装时应引导安装，不能宣称工具已可用或自行寻找其他本地生图软件。

settings.label: 图像
settings.keywords: 图像工坊 图片 生图 像素 去背景

model.description: Optional model override for this request only; otherwise uses the saved Image Studio model.

presetPrompt.description: Editable preset template. prompt supplies additional requirements.

background.description: solid adds a flat-background instruction to the prompt; auto leaves the background to the prompt.

removeBackground.description: Apply Image Studio local solid-background removal to generated pixels.

referenceImage.description: Single image data URL for reference-guided editing. Use either referenceImage or referenceImages.

referenceImages.description: Ordered image data URLs used together for each output; count is the output count, not a count per reference. Do not combine with referenceImage.

gridSize.description: Optional [width, height]; omit for automatic grid detection.

tools.name: modmind_image_studio_info
tools.description: Read saved Image Studio settings (no secrets), credential source and all editable presets. Set includeModels=true to query available models; a lookup failure is returned separately and does not hide settings.

tools.name: modmind_image_generate
tools.description: Generate or edit through the same Image Studio entry point, saved credentials and model as the UI. Read modmind_image_studio_info for presets and optionally models. Supports every generation parameter; model is a per-request override. Never requires separate agent credentials. Each output records a project path and, up to 8 MiB, a dataUrl for processing or Blockbench.

tools.name: modmind_image_perfect_pixel
tools.description: Run Image Studio PerfectPixel with the same adjustable parameters as the UI. Omit perfectPixel.gridSize for automatic detection.

tools.name: modmind_image_remove_background
tools.description: Remove a detected solid background from an image data URL. Use the returned image as a transparent draft and inspect edges before saving.

capabilities.name: 物品与装备
capabilities.description: 创建、编辑和校验项目物品与装备，按版本查询原版物品只读参照并导入贴图。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_items_query
tools.description: Read managed project items with their revision or the version-matched vanilla item catalog. Read the current revision before changing an item.

tools.name: modmind_items_manage
tools.description: Save or remove a managed item through the same service as the item editor. Saving requires definition {item,revision}; removal requires id and the current revision. Existing generator validation, version support and rollback apply.

capabilities.name: Mappings
capabilities.description: 查询目标 Minecraft 版本的类、字段和方法命名映射，已缓存结果支持离线查看。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_mapping_search
tools.description: Search mappings.dev for the active Minecraft version.

tools.name: modmind_mapping_class
tools.description: Inspect an exact mapped Minecraft class and optional member query.

capabilities.name: 媒体格式转换支持
capabilities.description: 为声音和发布插件提供本地音频转换；这两个插件需要先安装并启用媒体处理支持。

capabilities.name: 模型
capabilities.description: 通过内嵌 Blockbench 创建、编辑、预览和保存模型，并编辑资源包中的模型。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by modmind_blockbench_project_state. Include it when editing an existing project so concurrent manual changes are not overwritten.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_project_state
tools.description: Read the complete live Blockbench project structure, including a content revision, cubes, groups, meshes, textures, animations, UV state, and selection. Read this before editing an existing model.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_validate
tools.description: Validate the live Blockbench project for missing parents, group cycles, invalid cube bounds, texture problems, duplicate names, and missing animation targets.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_capture_views
tools.description: Render 1-6 model-only PNG views through Blockbench offscreen camera presets. Returns MCP image content for visual review without moving the visible camera.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_actions
tools.description: Execute a validated, serialized Blockbench action batch. Inspect first and pass expectedRevision when editing an existing project. The result returns revisions before and after the batch.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_history
tools.description: List the last 20 restorable Blockbench checkpoints created before accepted edit batches.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a named checkpoint of the complete editable Blockbench project.

tools.name: modmind_blockbench_restore_history
tools.description: Restore one Blockbench checkpoint transactionally and retain the current state as a new checkpoint.

tools.name: modmind_asset_compile_intent
tools.description: Compile an Ashfox-style Asset Intent Program into a deterministic Blockbench candidate without changing the open project. Use this for whole-asset generation; inspect the candidate summary and diagnostics before applying it.

tools.name: modmind_asset_preview_intent
tools.description: Build an Asset Intent candidate in a temporary Blockbench tab, validate it, return visual review images, then discard the temporary tab and restore the original project. This never accepts or keeps the candidate.

tools.name: modmind_asset_apply_intent
tools.description: Compile and apply an Ashfox-style Asset Intent Program as one validated Blockbench batch. Pass expectedRevision when replacing or editing an existing project. The compiler rejects invalid intent before any action runs.

tools.name: modmind_asset_compile_refinement
tools.description: Compile a structured refinement against the current Blockbench project without changing it. Returns exact update actions, diagnostics, source metadata, and the base revision.

tools.name: modmind_asset_preview_refinement
tools.description: Clone the current Blockbench project, apply a structured refinement to the clone, validate and capture it for visual review, then discard the clone.

tools.name: modmind_asset_apply_refinement
tools.description: Compile and transactionally apply a structured refinement to the current Blockbench project. Pass expectedRevision to reject concurrent manual changes; failures restore the previous project snapshot.

tools.name: modmind_asset_compile_advanced
tools.description: Compile editable cubes, wedges, cylinders, spheres, profile extrusions, Catmull-Rom tubes, UVs, armatures, weights, IK, locators, animations, and up to three variants.

tools.name: modmind_asset_preview_advanced
tools.description: Render and visually score A/B/C advanced asset candidates, run up to three bounded score-driven correction rounds, and return the best candidate without keeping temporary projects.

tools.name: modmind_asset_apply_advanced
tools.description: Apply one selected advanced editable asset candidate as a validated Blockbench transaction.

tools.name: modmind_asset_compile_reference
tools.description: Analyze a PNG, JPEG, or WebP reference, extract its silhouette and palette, and compile an editable extruded Mesh candidate.

tools.name: modmind_asset_preview_reference
tools.description: Build, render, validate, and visually score a reference-image Mesh candidate without keeping the temporary project.

tools.name: modmind_asset_apply_reference
tools.description: Apply a reference-image silhouette as a native editable Blockbench Mesh.

tools.name: modmind_asset_visual_review
tools.description: Capture the current model and score framing, occupancy, contrast, edge density, symmetry, clipping, cross-view consistency, and optional reference silhouette proportions.

capabilities.name: 依赖与优化
capabilities.description: 生成并安装 Mod 方案，审计锁定清单以及选择和应用优化档。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_apply_optimization_profile
tools.description: Resolve and install a conservative optimization profile, then apply only explicitly declared configuration patches.

capabilities.name: 文件清单
capabilities.description: 查看和编辑整合包清单、配置、脚本、数据包、光影、界面、世界、玩家预设与服务端内容。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_download_content
tools.description: Download arbitrary HTTPS modpack content through ModMind verified download, size limits, hashing, inventory tracking, and safe world extraction. Covers config, scripts, datapacks, quests, resource packs, shader packs, UI files, worlds, client/server files, and other pack content.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_apply_keybinds
tools.description: Apply a keybind preset to pack options.txt and reject conflicts by default.

capabilities.name: 版本迁移
capabilities.description: 评估目标版本与依赖兼容性，选择迁移取舍、生成迁移结果并恢复历史迁移。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_migration_targets
tools.description: List supported Minecraft and Loader targets for migrating the active modpack.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_migration_preview
tools.description: Scan the active modpack against a target and return official files, replacements, source ports, missing or unknown mods, MC百科 evidence, custom content, and source JAR dossiers without changing the project.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_migration_apply
tools.description: Apply migration decisions in the original project directory. Defaults to backup mode and permits deferred unresolved mods. Mod actions: use-compatible, use-replacement, manual-file, create-compat-module, remove, or defer.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_migration_history
tools.description: Read migration records, incomplete results, reports, backup availability, and undo state.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_migration_undo
tools.description: Undo a backup-mode migration. ModMind always snapshots the current post-migration state before restoring the source snapshot.

capabilities.name: 模组列表
capabilities.description: 浏览和管理整合包模组及自制模块，通过兼容平台搜索、下载和安装 Mod。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_plan
tools.description: Resolve a modpack concept into compatible Modrinth/CurseForge candidates, recursively resolve required dependencies, and return conflicts plus an install review without downloading files.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_apply_plan
tools.description: Download and hash-lock every resolved mod in a validated modpack plan.

tools.name: modmind_mcmod_search
tools.description: Query MC百科 for China-only Mod metadata when Modrinth and CurseForge have no compatible replacement. This tool is read-only and cannot download files or request a captcha.

tools.name: modmind_mcmod_files
tools.description: List public MC百科 file metadata for one numeric project ID. This tool excludes download tokens, cookies, captcha data, and download actions.

capabilities.name: Patchouli 指南书
capabilities.description: 创建和编辑 Patchouli 指南书、分类和条目并保存到当前整合包。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_modpack_write_patchouli_book
tools.description: Write a validated Patchouli book, categories, entries and pages into pack overrides.

capabilities.name: 发布
capabilities.description: 配置发布平台、运行发布预检并发布项目，管理原发布工作流。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

settings.label: 发布平台
settings.keywords: 发布平台 平台绑定 Modrinth CurseForge GitHub Token 令牌 项目 ID 仓库 release publish

tools.name: modmind_validate_content
tools.description: Validate project JSON, OGG headers, and sound references without changing files.

tools.name: modmind_release_preflight
tools.description: Inspect release artifact, metadata, license, version, and changelog readiness.

capabilities.name: 前置与联动
capabilities.description: 浏览、下载和管理前置模组及开发依赖，处理服务端插件依赖与联动。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_dependency_search
tools.description: Search Modrinth for projects compatible with the active Loader and Minecraft version.

tools.name: modmind_dependency_install
tools.description: Install a compatible Modrinth dependency through the managed Gradle and test-instance integration.

tools.name: modmind_maven_dependency_install
tools.description: Register a Maven dependency through ModMind managed Gradle blocks. Use this instead of editing Gradle dependency or repository blocks directly when the requested library is available from Maven.

tools.name: modmind_addon_relationships
tools.description: Read prepared add-on targets, exact versions, artifact/source paths, public package summaries, and license constraints.

tools.name: modmind_addon_prepare
tools.description: Prepare one or more add-on target mods by exact name. Resolves compatible Modrinth/CurseForge projects and required transitive dependencies, downloads and verifies runtime JARs, obtains exact-version sources when available, updates Gradle and loader metadata, and synchronizes the test instance. Use this before implementing a request to extend another mod.

tools.name: modmind_addon_import
tools.description: Import project-relative JAR files as add-on targets only when their hashes identify exact platform files. Ambiguous files are rejected for batch confirmation in the UI.

tools.name: modmind_addon_link_project
tools.description: Build and link another existing ModMind Java mod project as a required add-on target. The path must point to a ModMind project with the same Minecraft version and Loader.

capabilities.name: 资源包
capabilities.description: 创建、导入、编辑、校验、部署和导出资源包，与已安装图像工坊、模型插件交接当前资源。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_resource_pack
tools.description: Manage Java resource packs in the current project: list, create, validate, export, deploy. Source editing uses normal project file tools. All exports are validated.

capabilities.name: ServerPackCreator
capabilities.description: 为游戏与服务端测试提供受校验的 ServerPackCreator 8.1.2，按需安装的服务端打包依赖。

capabilities.name: ServerPackCreator 资源
capabilities.description: 服务端打包组件的配套资源，随依赖自动安装。

capabilities.name: 声音
capabilities.description: 管理声音事件、导入音频并创作音效与音乐，保留原声音工作流。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_sound_library
tools.description: Read the current Java mod project sound library, one event, the editable studio draft, or preview one locally available audio item. List is paged; preview never downloads Minecraft assets and is limited to 4 MiB.

tools.name: modmind_sound_create
tools.description: Edit a project sound event, save an editable sound studio draft, render and export a studio draft as OGG, process an existing audio item, or undo the latest sound change. Uses the same project service as the UI. Read the current draft/event revision first; exports write project audio and sounds.json.

capabilities.name: 客户端与玩家测试
capabilities.description: 准备隔离的 Minecraft 测试实例，进行有界面或无头启动测试、玩家操作、截图与场景验证。

capabilities.name: 服务端测试
capabilities.description: 启动、停止和验证本机服务器，管理服务端核心、联机测试、日志与命令场景，生成和导出服务端包。

capabilities.name: 自动检查
capabilities.description: 运行客户端、专用服务器、GameTest 和构建矩阵；生成持续集成工作流。

tools.name: modmind_local_server
tools.description: Manage the current project local server: state, start, stop, command or scenario. Uses managed core downloads and isolated persistent instances. Start does not prove plugin behavior; scenario requires fresh expected evidence.

tools.name: modmind_test_rendered
tools.description: Build/sync and test a visible owned Minecraft client. Supported Java mods use the pinned Minecraft Mod MCP integration and return an actual screenshot plus GUI/player/world observations, then stop. Other versions/modpacks use startup checks only. Inspect returned images before claiming visual verification. For continued interaction use modmind_test_session with mode rendered. Requires real-interface testing.

tools.name: modmind_test_session
tools.description: Manage an owned player test: capabilities, start, state, stop. Java mod projects use Minecraft Mod MCP in rendered mode, with isolated game files and native screenshots; navigate the title screen to create or enter a test world. Plugin/modpack tests use their supported HeadlessMC path. Probe capabilities first. Keep sessionId and stop when done. Headless cannot prove visuals.

tools.name: modmind_test_observe
tools.description: Read fresh GUI or client logs. Java mod MCP observations also include player/world state. GUI revision must accompany click/text/scroll. HeadlessMC logs support a cursor; tooltip only if advertised.

tools.name: modmind_test_action
tools.description: Operate the test player: inventory, close, click, text, command, key. Native mod MCP also supports look(yaw,pitch), scroll(clicks), interact, coordinate click(x,y,button), and text with pressEnter. Click/text/scroll need latest revision; slot means GUI button index, not inventory slot for native MCP. Commands require in-game permissions and can build with setblock/fill. Operator is only for plugin/modpack owned test servers. Action acknowledgement is not gameplay success; do not blindly retry.

tools.name: modmind_test_capture
tools.description: Capture a new actual rendered-client screenshot if supported. Never accepts headless or blank frames as visual evidence.

tools.name: modmind_test_scenario
tools.description: Run up to 20 player actions with expected output text per step. Records versioned evidence; stops on failed assertions. Does not prove visual correctness.

tools.name: modmind_test_matrix
tools.description: Run selected managed build, client, server, or GameTest targets.

tools.name: modmind_test_minecraft
tools.description: Build and launch the isolated ModMind Minecraft test instance, then return startup/crash evidence.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_build_server
tools.description: Deterministically build the initial server pack by invoking the pinned open-source ServerPackCreator CLI. This tool does not use AI, does not modify the AI workspace, and excludes unknown-side mods by default; return the generated manifest, skipped mods, engine version and log path.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_verify_server_join
tools.description: Build a loopback-only local server in offline test mode, wait for its ready port, and verify a HeadlessMC client joins with transcript evidence. Set onlineMode true only for an explicit authenticated-server test.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_run_server_scenario
tools.description: Start a loopback-only local server in offline test mode and execute bounded console commands with log evidence assertions.

tools.name: modmind_runtime_state
tools.description: Read the current isolated Minecraft test runtime state and recent events. Modpacks also return modpackImport with installed counts, pending dependencies and original-pack compatibility warnings; import success does not prove gameplay compatibility.

capabilities.name: 版本记录
capabilities.description: 创建、查看、恢复和删除项目快照，管理 Git 版本以及 Java 与服务端插件迁移。安装并启用后才可使用；能力目录不代表当前工具已经开放。

tools.name: modmind_version_query
tools.description: Read the current project Git status, diff or remote list using the version-management service.

tools.name: modmind_version_manage
tools.description: Perform version-management commands in the current project: initialize, commit, createBranch, fetch, pull, push, merge or rebase. Use operation-specific fields and review project status before changes.
